proposed.text: Per PD 1096 Rule XII, Sec. 1210.e, at what cross-sectional area does a rooftop tower require its supporting structural frame to extend all the way to the ground?
proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Per Rule XII, Sec. 1210.e, if a tower's cross-sectional area exceeds 10.00 sq.m at any point above the roof, its supporting structural frame must extend down to the ground level — not just to the roof. Large towers generate substantial overturning moments from wind and seismic forces that require continuous load path to the foundation.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096, Rule XII, Sec. 1212 / RA 9514 (Fire Code)
